headline: Bank of Japan Governor Ueda reaffirms commitment to interest rate hikes
summary: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda told parliament that the central bank should continue raising interest rates to keep underlying inflation anchored near its 2% target.
why: The Bank of Japan is normalizing monetary policy after decades of ultra-easy rates, a shift with profound consequences for Japanese government bond yields and global currency carry trades.

impacts.name: Japan policy rate
impacts.why: The governor explicitly stated that the BOJ should continue to raise policy interest rates.
